collections.name: Starter pack
collections.description: Three templates to get a fresh instance moving: an inbound webhook, a scheduled database export, and an error alert. Each one works without any custom nodes.

collections.name: DevX Message Connector scenarios
collections.description: Eleven examples covering Text, HTML, Adaptive Card, Generic, Rocket.Chat, GitHub pull requests and workflow runs, Backup Container, Sysdig, StatusCake, and Uptime.com. Text, HTML, Adaptive Card, and Generic start manually; the seven known source formats start with source-specific POST webhooks. Every example uses Preview mode, which calls the configured DevX preview endpoint without posting to Teams.

collections.name: CHEFS and approval patterns
collections.description: Two complete human-in-the-loop examples: a CHEFS Event Subscription review and same-execution resubmission loop, and a multi-actor CHEFS form approval coordinated by Multi Webhook Wait.

collections.name: Operational Teams notifications
collections.description: Five documented webhook-to-Adaptive-Card workflows for deployment status, DNS routing changes, Grafana alerts, custom Sysdig alerts, and GitHub secret scanning alerts. Every example starts in DevX Preview mode.
